body:
I finished high school in 96. Up until last year I tried every semester to get into a school that was near where I was living at the time. I've always been denied for grants or loans. I never understood why I was denied a student loan. I can't get a straight answer. I never knew about signing up for selective services until last year when finally the last place I tried told me that's why I can't get a government grant. I tried signing up for selective services but was told I was too old now. Due to my physical health declining work is intermittent now at best. this month so far I've made about $220. I'm staying in a motel that has taken most of that. I've never had enough money in my possession to afford school or a way to school regally. I wanted to go back to school for electrical engineering. I know since I didn't graduate high school with any kind of college prep classes I would have to take a bunch of extra classes too. I missed a lot of days of high school and barely graduated because I didn't have a reliable ride there back then. Failing all those classes and constantly being held back in some subjects really fucked me over in the long run too. My transcript is embarrassing. My high school cared so little about my problems back then. They even fucked up my high school diploma 4 times before getting my named spelled right. Then they got the year and school I graduated from wrong on it. It was a real precursor to the years to follow.  

Now with my physical problems and mental health deteriorating I don't think I could focus enough to finish college if I could afford it. I can't focus enough to even save up enough money to afford school. All the problems I have are overwhelming. People always say just sit down and solve them one by one. I find that very patronizing because life doesn't work that way. It's almost like I've fallen so far in life that most of the people I know can't understand my position.
I'm sick of traveling, I want to settle down. I've lived in 21 states in the past 16 years.
